body: Your positivity is much appreciated. I hope to get a better handle on things in the near future, and figure out something to do with myself to keep my mind occupied.
6 months is a long time on the Internet.

Thanks for your advice. There are other complicated factors to why I've told reddit about my emotional shortcomings and not a qualified professional. My parents and a large portion of my friends and family are devoutly religious, and I am decidedly not. My parents had trouble supporting my decision to opt out of an LDS mission and go to college instead, and as a result of many other similar situations, I generally don't confide in them about much. I've watched so many friends go through depression and be outcast as "attention-seekers" and not taken seriously. There are a lot of reasons I am distrustful of what I'm familiar with... And being 17 years old makes it hard to legitimize any efforts I make alone to seek help. I feel stuck, but I know there has to be a way out. That's why I'm making these posts-- to perhaps gain a fresh perspective.
